summary: Observation sheets for investigation OT-08-S0114, the AP02 discovery genotoxicity battery for Avernelwick Pharmaceuticals Ltd. The HepG2 viability screen, the bacterial mutation assay with and without S9 and the mammalian-cell micronucleus assessment were run across the 24 test articles in the series. Bacterial results were negative throughout; the mammalian scoring is kept on its own sheet, as Avernelwick asked for the two signals to be reported separately.

rows: Mammalian-cell micronucleus assessment (TK6). Treatment 3 h with and without S9, recovery to 24 h. Percent micronucleated cells, RPD against vehicle.
Scoring on each culture by two readers, blind to treatment. Discordant reads are re-scored by the study director.

comments.text: Mammalian signal does not line up with the Ames plates. Discuss at the next QA gate before Avernelwick sees the sheet.
